biggest_catch: Business accounts only and the business checking account must be opened IN A BRANCH (promo code 2026EM). The $500 tier requires parking $10,000 for 90 days. Offer expires 2026-10-31; OR/WA/CA/ID residents only.
catches: Open a new Banner Bank business checking account at a Banner Bank branch and use promotional code 2026EM at account opening.
Must not already have a Banner Bank business checking account; offer not available to local/state/federal government entities, nonprofits, political action committees, or campaign accounts.
Not available to businesses whose Banner accounts were closed within the last 2 years, or closed within 90 days / closed with a negative balance in the last 3 years.
One new-account-opening bonus every 2 years per business entity with a unique tax ID on business checking.
Offer available to residents of OR, WA, CA, and ID only.
$250 tier: deposit a minimum of $5,000 into the new business checking account within 60 days AND maintain a minimum balance of $5,000 for 90 days.
$500 tier: deposit a minimum of $10,000 into the new business checking account within 60 days AND maintain a minimum balance of $10,000 for 90 days.
Bonus deposited into the new account within 30 days after requirements are met; account must be open and in good standing at payout.
Offer expires 10/31/2026; subject to change without notice; may not be combined with any other offer.
Bonus is considered interest and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.

c1.evidence: Banner Bank (bannerbank.com) is a real regional bank; its 'Explore Business Account Bonus Offers' page publishes the 2026EM business bonus terms (official search crawls, confirmed ~3-6 days ago).

c2.evidence: Official page: 'To receive the business checking or savings offers, you must open your account(s) at a Banner Bank branch and use the promotional code 2026EM at account opening... To receive the $250 checking bonus: Open any new Banner Bank business checking account AND deposit a minimum of $5,000 into that account within 60 days AND maintain a minimum balance of $5,000 for 90 days. To receive the $500 checking bonus: Open any new Banner Bank business checking account AND deposit a minimum of $10,000 into that account within 60 days AND maintain a minimum balance of $10,000 for 90 days.'

c3.evidence: Both tiers, deposit thresholds, 60-day funding window, 90-day maintenance, branch requirement, code 2026EM, geography, and 10/31/2026 expiry are quoted verbatim from the official page.

eligibility: New Banner Bank business checking customers (no existing business checking); not government/nonprofit/PAC/campaign accounts; no Banner accounts closed within 2 years (90 days or negative-balance closure in last 3 years also excluded); OR/WA/CA/ID residents only; one bonus per 2 years per tax ID.

steps: Open a new Banner Bank business checking account at a branch with promotional code 2026EM.
Deposit a minimum of $5,000 ($250 tier) or $10,000 ($500 tier) into the account within 60 days.
Maintain the minimum balance for 90 days.
The bonus is deposited into the new account within 30 days after the requirements are met.
